## How to review

Read each row. For each translation, check that it says the same thing as the English, in words a speaker of this language would use. Mark anything stiff, wrong or unnatural. The English column is the source of truth.
To record a review, fill `reviewedBy` and `reviewedOn` in `_meta` of `src/i18n/locales/th.json` and set `source` to `human-reviewed`. The AI label then disappears for this language.

## Lines marked ⚠ (meaning differs a little)

- `civics.officialNote`: "Any one of these answers counts" is rendered "counts as correct" (นับว่าถูก), slightly stronger.
- `report.lead.onTrack`: "civics" is rendered as "civic duties" (หน้าที่พลเมือง), as elsewhere in the Thai file.
